categories.main_business_segments: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power and heat generation, including operation of power plants through subsidiaries, generating electric power and heat for sale. It also has other segments involving aluminium smelting, coal mining, and treatment of flyash, though these are immaterial compared to the core power generation business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a mix of coal-fired power generation with ultra-supercritical units, hydropower, wind power, photovoltaic power, and gas turbines. It has completed ultra-low emission environmental protection transformations for coal-fired units and focuses on green and low-carbon technologies, including new energy bases and advanced coal-fired power with low carbon emissions and flexibility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are external power grid companies across China, with major electricity supply responsibilities in regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and the southeast coastal areas. The company also serves heating markets in northern cities and participates in national power markets and cross-provincial electricity trading.
categories.geographic_coverage: Datang Power operates across 20 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China, with coal-fired power concentrated in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and southeast coastal regions, hydropower in the southwest, and wind and photovoltaic projects distributed nationwide in resource-rich areas. The company is listed in Hong Kong, London, and Shanghai, but its operations are primarily domestic within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and heat supply. It procures coal and other fuels, manages power plants, and sells electricity and heat to grid companies and end users. It also engages in related services such as coal supply and transportation through connected transactions with its controlling shareholder.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include green and low-carbon transformation, multi-energy complementarity, digital intelligence, and high efficiency. The company emphasizes development of new energy sources like wind, photovoltaic, hydropower, and gas turbines, upgrading coal-fired power units for low emissions and flexibility, and exploring emerging technologies such as offshore wind, energy storage, green hydrogen, and carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electric power and heat to external power grid companies. The company also earns income from other segments such as aluminium smelting and coal mining, as well as related services including coal supply, technical services, and infrastructure contracting. Inter-segment sales occur at market prices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Datang Power is one of the largest independent power generation companies in China, with a strong market position supported by its large installed capacity and diversified energy portfolio. It competes with other major Chinese power companies and state-owned enterprises in the energy sector, focusing on green transformation and cost leadership to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company has total assets of approximately RMB 322.6 billion and an installed capacity of about 79.1 GW. Operating revenue reached RMB 123.5 billion with a profit before tax of RMB 8.7 billion, marking a significant increase in profitability and operating efficiency. The company has shown steady growth in installed capacity, especially in clean energy, with a 40.37% share of low-carbon energy sources.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Datang Power emphasizes its role as a pillar central state-owned enterprise ensuring energy security and supply stability. Its value proposition includes a diversified energy mix with a growing proportion of clean and low-carbon energy, advanced ultra-supercritical coal technology, and strong operational efficiency. The company also highlights its commitment to green transformation, innovation in new energy technologies, and cost leadership to deliver high-quality, reliable, and sustainable energy solutions.
